title: •_Redemption_
caption: •_Redemption_ (V)
game_text: May add 4 pilots and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Bacta Tank deploys for free and is lost if _Redemption_ lost. X on Bacta Tank is -2. [Ship-docking]
lore: Nebulon-B frigate used as a mobile medical facility. Extra cargo space and weapon batteries have been modified to allow for more armor and more recovery areas.

notes: Unique. 'Redemption' italic in the slip's heading, caption and game text (marked _…_ as vs6/05). Banner CAPITAL: MODIFIED NEBULON-B FRIGATE. Stats POWER 4 / ARMOR 5 / HYPERSPEED 4; deploy 3 / forfeit 6. Scomp-link ring at the top-left of the text box → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: yellow Pilot helmet (permanent-pilot, 'Permanent pilot provides ability of 2'), red square with green dome → nav. The slip prints '[Ship-docking]' literally in square brackets where the stub writes 'Ship-docking capability.' Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 348×488; copyright 1997 (Cloud City) not legible here. Modern: V5-L-redemption.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 5 remake); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
